Find the center and radius of the osculating circle to the curve r(t) at the point P(3,1) where t=π2, given that ‖r′(π2)‖=2, and the unit tangent vector to the curve is T(t)=⟨cos⁡t,−sin⁡t⟩.

a
The center is (0,1) and the radius is 10
b
The center is (1,1) and the radius is 2
c
The center is (1,0) and the radius is 1
d
The center is (1,1) and the radius is π2
e
The center is (0,0) and the radius is 1
